narr: A very strong thunderstorm developed near McCook during the afternoon, remaining nearly stationary for roughly two hours over the town before moving east. During this time the thunderstorm produced hail over three inches in diameter, wind gusts up to 60 MPH, and closed to six inches of rainfall. The prolonged heavy rainfall caused rushing water to be close to a foot deep in the low lying areas of McCook.||Elsewhere thunderstorm activity produced much smaller hail in Hitchcock and Dundy counties.
ev: Prolonged heavy rainfall over McCook caused rushing water to be roughly a foot deep on streets located in the valleys of town.
lsr: Photos of flash flooding 2 miles northwest of McCook.
Draws in town are flowing close to a foot deep as water flows down streets.
